opening: The rash, fever, muscle and joint aches, dark urine, itching and belly pain have been going on for 10 days.
The rash and the yellowing began about 20 days after I started nevirapine.
My skin and the whites of my eyes have turned yellow.
Forty-five days ago my HIV medicines were changed and I started nevirapine, together with zidovudine and lamivudine.
I take zidovudine for my HIV; I've been on it for the past three years.

opening.text: I have HIV and I've been taking zidovudine for the past three years, but forty-five days ago my medicines were changed to include nevirapine along with zidovudine and lamivudine. About twenty days after starting nevirapine, I developed a rash and my skin and the whites of my eyes turned yellow. I've also had a fever, my skin itches, my urine has been dark, and I have muscle and joint aches with belly pain. All of these symptoms have been going on for 10 days.
